statements.text: A quasi-phenomenal property is a non-phenomenal, physical property, perhaps a complex and gerrymandered one, that introspection typically misrepresents as phenomenal. Quasi-phenomenal redness is the physical property that typically triggers introspective representations of phenomenal redness. Such properties are nothing feely and pose no special explanatory problem. Frankish elsewhere calls them zero qualia.
